mentions.heading: Future changes to Dutch, U.S. and other foreign tax laws could adversely affect us.
mentions.detail: EU Pillar 2 directive effective 2024 enacted in Netherlands; OECD/G7 June 2025 side-by-side safe harbor may amend rules
mentions.quote: As part of the OECD framework to implement a minimum tax rate, the EU has adopted a directive on ensuring a global minimum level of taxation for multinational companies, also known as Pillar 2, which became effective in 2024.

mentions.heading: We are exposed to a number of different tax uncertainties, which could have an impact on our results.
mentions.detail: Transfer-pricing directives on goods, services, financing per OECD guidelines; cross-border disputes with local tax authorities
mentions.quote: As transfer pricing has a cross-border effect, the focus of local tax authorities on implemented transfer pricing procedures in a country may have an impact on results in another country.

mentions.heading: We are exposed to a number of different tax uncertainties, which could have an impact on our results.
mentions.detail: Tax assets from acquisitions and loss carryforwards may be challenged or require future taxable profits
mentions.quote: Tax authorities may challenge these tax assets. In addition, the value of the tax assets resulting from tax losses carried forward depends on having sufficient taxable profits in the future.
